thread:
maya: Quick kickoff — I want to run a 3-week community push called 'Snippet Circuit' focused on tiny refapps + micro-benchmarks + a 30min hands-on webinar. Goal: drive dev signups and repo stars. Need launch post + benchmark narrative + webinar landing + inbound routing plan. Who can own which?

sam: I'm happy to own the launch post + tweet thread. Target publish Tue 4/6. I'll draft by Mon EOD.

jordan: I can handle the benchmark narrative and sample results. Leaning on mobile latency and token cost per request. Need benchmark targets from eng-ml.

emily: I'll do webinar moderation + slides. 30 min demo + 15 Q&A. Prefer Wed 4/14 evening US.

chris: I'll set up routing in HubSpot and update the inbound flow. Quick Q: do we gate the benchmark report behind email?

maya: @chris let's do soft-gate: gated for the detailed CSV, but summary public. Also add utm=snippet-circuit.

sam: draft outline: 1) TL;DR 2) why it matters 3) quickstart 4) benchmarks 5) try it now 6) CTA. Will include a 'run locally in 3 steps' snippet:
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/snippet-circuit.git
python -m venv venv
./run_demo.sh
```

jordan: For benchmarks I'll compare a small Llama variant vs quantized on CPU/GPU. Need sample token lengths: 32/128/512. Will include per-token cost calc and a tiny table.

emily: webinar ops: need two demo laptops, set up recording, registration page, and a short eval prompt set. Also can we have a follow-up email with the benchmark PDF + repo link.

chris: routing plan: create a lead form with hidden field 'snippet_circuit=true', tag leads with 'snip-circuit-2026', segment for dev and enterprise. Add follow-up drip: immediate email with quickstart + 48h nurture with benchmark.

maya: timeline = publish launch post 4/6, benchmark blog 4/9, webinar 4/14, follow-up drip over two weeks. Owners: sam (launch), jordan (bench), emily (webinar), chris (routing).

jordan: Need eng-ml contact for sample perf numbers — will loop in @zara.

sam: I'll post copy in #marketing-drafts for review Thu. ping @design for hero assets; ask for 2 variants: code-first and product-first.

emily: I'll create the event on Zoom and add registration. Can someone drop a 1-line hero blurb for the landing page?

content-bot: Reminder: content calendar slot reserved 4/6 for "Snippet Circuit".

maya: OK small ask: short 1-liner for the launch post due Mon EOD from each owner. :rocket:

chris: I'll prototype the HubSpot form and share JSON snippet here tomorrow.

sam: cool — will aim to include a short benchmark highlight in the hero (e.g., "up to 4x faster on small models, 60% lower token cost with caching").

maya: Perfect. Thanks team — synch in #marketing-ops at 11am PST tomorrow for a 15-min status check.
